column1: # Curated enrollment of published pretrained-model assets (ITEM-2). One row per
# catalogue entry; generated by `gen_pretrained_catalogue.py` into the three
# PROV-PC-1 files. Columns:
#   id               catalogue id (stable slug, e.g. relchange-threshold)
#   version          asset version (semver; an asset change is a NEW version)
#   kind             published-rule | benchmark-trained
#   method_id        the method whose frozen model this asset carries
#   tag              the tinnlab/txresbench-models release tag (e.g. <id>-v1.0.0)
#   file             the release asset file name (<id>@<version>.txr)
#   sha256           64-hex lowercase sha256 of the packed .txr (packer output)
#   size_bytes       the packed .txr size (packer output)
#   bundled          true | false | "" (= size <= 20 MiB default per DEC-5)
#   sources          ";"-separated data sources: a dataset id resolved through
#                    dev/code/manifest/datasets.csv + datasets/<id>/dataset.yaml
#                    (access, licence), or an inline paper-cohort source
#                    "name|access|licence" (access must be open)
#   licence          the model's DATA licence ("" = resolved from sources)
#   tree, facts      the packer inputs (relative to the repo or SIGTRANS_ROOT);
#                    empty when the publish workspace keeps them (the packer
#                    --verify + the runbook record the sha256/size instead)
#   name, description, citation   the card text
#   decision_day, endpoint, horizon, task   the asset's analysis facts
#   transfer_metric  auc_rule | c_index | "" (the card's "other cohorts" metric)
# Rows are added by the OWNER at publish time (scripts/pretrained-catalogue/README.md):
# pack the --frozen /model tree -> record the packer's size_bytes/sha256 ->
# publish the release asset -> add the row here -> regenerate + commit.
# There are no rows yet: no frozen assets are published (owner-gated).
# id
